_comment: Wapsi plan explainer - voiceover script. 'gapBefore' is silence (seconds) inserted before the line in the master mix; it is how pacing and the held beats are authored. Phonetic respellings are deliberate: SAPI mangles 'Wapsi', so it is written 'Wahpsee'. The rupee glyph is never spoken and no section numbers are read aloud. l12's long gapBefore is the uncomfortable spinner hold.

lines.text: Two thirds of the people who file India's income tax return owe nothing.
They are not debtors. They are creditors, waiting on their own money.
This is the most common thing the portal says to them.
It is not an error message. It is a shrug.
Here is the same failure, told truthfully.
The department already holds her salary, and the tax taken from it.
So stop asking people to compose a return.
Ask them to confirm one.
Every figure names who reported it, and when. She is checking someone else's work, not risking her own.
In Hindi. In Tamil. The whole interface, not a chatbot bolted on.
Then she waits.
Seventy one days. This is everything she is told.
So make the waiting legible. Seven steps, and you see where you are.
The step holding your money names its own reason,
and carries the button that releases it.
When something comes back, it comes back written in law.
Say it in money and days. If she says nothing by the fourteenth of September, it becomes final and is taken from her refund.
Three acts, one journey. File by confirming. Understand what comes back. Watch the money move.
Wahpsee. The return, and your money coming back.
Round one closes on the twenty eighth of August, at eight in the evening.
